newsitem.title: GREECE: Salomon issues a buy recommendation for Greek OTE.
newsitem.headline: Salomon issues a buy recommendation for Greek OTE.

text.p: Salomon Brothers has issued a buy recommendation for Greek OTE telecom citing an 18 percent rise in first-half net income, an on-target investment plan and expected strong revenue growth as timed charging is extended.
It also noted plans by OTE to enter the lucrative cellular telephone market, expected in less than a year.

State managed OTE floated eight percent of its shares on the bourse in March this year at 4,000 drachmas a share including a dividend of 130 drachmas for fiscal 1995 paid to its stockholders in July 1996.
After an initial sharp rise, OTE shares fell to around their 4,000 drachma IPO price.
OTE closed at 4,100 drachmas on Friday, a 20 drachma rise on Thursday. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
